description: This PHP class defines a console command for creating a database savepoint within the OrangeHRM testing framework. It extends a base Command class, registers command name and arguments, and executes the savepoint creation thus facilitating database state management during tests.

classes.name: CreateDatabaseSavepointCommand
classes.description: Defines a CLI command to create a database savepoint, used in testing scenarios to rollback or snapshot database states.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CLI command: 'instance:create-db-savepoint'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description and required 'savepointName' argument.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Creates a database savepoint using the provided name, outputs success message with the number of tables dumped, and returns success status.
